repositories.name: agent-ai-discovery
repositories.role: AI-native discovery metadata, machine-readable entrypoints, published capability indexes, and opt-in agent integration.

repositories.name: mrcakes931-ecosystem
repositories.role: Human-facing ecosystem guide, navigation, onboarding, and project relationships.

repositories.name: agent-ecosystem-integration
repositories.role: Cross-repository integration profiles, adapter safety contracts, interoperability guidance, and conformance validation.

repositories.name: agent-foundation-spec
repositories.role: Normative foundation requirements, security and reliability invariants, lifecycle, and compatibility contracts.

repositories.name: agent-resource-manifest
repositories.role: Portable manifests for agent tools, skills, models, datasets, services, dependencies, and requested permissions.

repositories.name: agent-schema-registry
repositories.role: Versioned JSON Schemas, schema catalog governance, validation conventions, and compatibility rules.

repositories.name: agent-identity-trust
repositories.role: Principal identity data contracts, authentication context, authorization, delegation, revocation, and trust boundaries.

repositories.name: agent-secure-supply-chain
repositories.role: Release integrity, SBOMs, provenance, dependency and vulnerability management.

repositories.name: agent-policy-engine
repositories.role: Deterministic, default-deny policy decision evaluation for agent identities, actions, resources, and scopes; experimental evaluator, not a production enforcement boundary.

repositories.name: agent-audit-provenance
repositories.role: Portable audit event contracts, traceability, deterministic hash-chained records, and shared v1.1.0 capability metadata; authenticated and signed provenance remain future work.

repositories.name: aix-core
repositories.role: Experimental semantic interoperability specification for intent, tasks, responses, capabilities, context, status, errors, and provenance; extension layer over established protocols and transports with shared v1.1.0 capability metadata.

repositories.name: aix-codecs
repositories.role: Serialization, validation, and machine encodings for AIX.

repositories.name: agent-transport-gateway
repositories.role: Experimental transport-neutral request guard and integration boundary for AIX over HTTP, MCP and A2A; not a production gateway.

repositories.name: agent-discovery-network
repositories.role: Experimental trust-filtered discovery index for candidate agents, resources, services and capability advertisements; not authentication or authorization.

repositories.name: agent-capability-registry
repositories.role: Experimental catalog and validation of declared agent capabilities with policy-filtered candidate matching; advisory only, not authentication or authorization.

repositories.name: swarm-runtime
repositories.role: Execution infrastructure for distributed agents and nodes.

repositories.name: swarm-coordination
repositories.role: Task assignment, delegation, acknowledgement, synchronization, and recovery.

repositories.name: swarm-state-mesh
repositories.role: Distributed task state, context references, synchronization, and shared knowledge.

repositories.name: osint-source-registry
repositories.role: Review-gated catalog of public information sources, datasets, APIs and publication repositories, with licensing, permitted-purpose, access-limit, retention and approval metadata; no collection client.

repositories.name: osint-collection-framework
repositories.role: Authorized public-information collection through tools and adapters.

repositories.name: osint-evidence-engine
repositories.role: Evidence preservation, provenance, hashes, timestamps, and reproducibility.

repositories.name: osint-entity-resolution
repositories.role: Entity correlation, relationship modeling, and uncertainty reporting.

repositories.name: intelligence-knowledge-graph
repositories.role: Provenance-aware graph reference model linking source records, preserved evidence, entities and evidence-backed relationships with explicit uncertainty and bounded queries.

repositories.name: agent-tool-adapters
repositories.role: Experimental, dependency-free Python reference contract for explicit tool adapter registration, capability declarations, policy-gated invocation, and bounded JSON payloads; no bundled third-party adapters or sandbox runtime.

repositories.name: agent-skill-library
repositories.role: Experimental declarative skill package contract, versioned workflow schema, and dependency-free validator for machine-discoverable reusable workflows; no execution or publisher trust service.

repositories.name: agent-sandbox-security
repositories.role: Experimental sandbox admission policy contract and fail-closed reference validator; no OS isolation or workload execution.

repositories.name: agent-emergency-control
repositories.role: Independent emergency-stop authority, authenticated stop state, revocation, quarantine, distributed stop propagation, and controlled resumption.

repositories.name: agent-compliance-governance
repositories.role: Legal applicability register, compliance control catalogue, privacy and AI governance, evidence management, and regulatory change monitoring; not legal advice or certification.

repositories.name: agent-conformance-lab
repositories.role: Protocol contract validation, compatibility and security tests, with future isolated swarm benchmarking.

repositories.name: agent-federation-network
repositories.role: Federation between independently operated agent networks.

repositories.name: agent-ecosystem-private
repositories.role: Restricted internal research, security assessments, operational procedures, and controlled planning. Never a source for public sync.

licensing_policy.scope_note: Applies only to original material for which the relevant contributors have licensing rights. File-specific notices and upstream terms take precedence. Private operations repository is excluded pending separate internal licensing review.
